summary: Per-frame pit state machine dispatcher for a pit machine object. Reads the pit state at +0x184 (0 idle, 1 entering, 2 in-pit, 3 exiting, 4 post-collision) and routes: session-gated early return and collision-avoidance for states 0/4; a control-disabled collision path that forces state 4; entering-state timeout back to state 0; in-pit proximity collision that clears +0x190, transitions to state 3 and (for the active player vehicle) calls ConditionalIndexSetter(2); exiting-state pit-stop progress; and a pit-stop readiness check. A tail clears +0x1AC and notifies the session manager when the state is not 3.
